_metadata.scope: Publisher descriptions on public Ollama library pages; family-level guidance, not local runtime measurements.
_metadata.benchmark_caveat: Scores are omitted: published results cannot be attributed to local models without matching the exact checkpoint, quantization, inference settings, evaluation harness, and source.
_metadata.installation_caveat: Capabilities, context limits, runtime requirements, and availability vary by tag and Ollama version. Local API capabilities take precedence over family descriptions.

qwen3.5.summary: Qwen's multimodal family combines vision-language training with efficient hybrid architectures; check the installed variant.

lfm2.summary: Liquid's hybrid family targets efficient on-device deployment. The current page emphasizes 24B-A2B, not every variant.

ministral-3.summary: Mistral's edge-oriented family advertises vision, multilingual interaction, native function calling, and JSON output.

laguna-s-2.1.summary: Poolside's larger Laguna MoE model targets coding agents and interleaved reasoning, with substantial local memory needs.

laguna-xs-2.1.summary: Poolside's compact activated-parameter MoE targets local coding agents and optional interleaved thinking. The library warns of a macOS issue.

glm-5.2.summary: Z.ai's model targets long-running engineering workflows with advertised long context and adjustable thinking effort.

ornith.summary: An open coding-agent family whose training jointly optimizes agent scaffolds and solution trajectories.

qwen3-coder-next.summary: Hybrid-attention MoE coding model trained with executable tasks and environment interaction; the library describes it as non-thinking-only.

glm-4.7.summary: Z.ai's coding-oriented family supports thinking before acting and coding-agent integrations. The installed cloud service reports retirement; its historical use cases do not establish current availability.

availability.source: Local ollama show glm-4.7:cloud response observed 2026-11-06; replacement not installed or evaluated.

gpt-oss.summary: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning family offers configurable reasoning effort and tool-driven applications. Distinguish 20B and 120B variants.

phi4-mini-reasoning.summary: Microsoft's lightweight reasoning model targets logic-intensive mathematical tasks in constrained environments.

phi4-reasoning.summary: Microsoft's 14B reasoning and separately reinforced reasoning-plus variants have non-interchangeable evaluation results.

qwen3.summary: Qwen's dense and MoE language family covers reasoning, conversation, and agents; thinking behavior depends on checkpoint.

qwen3-coder.summary: Qwen's coding family emphasizes executable software tasks, repository context, and coding-agent workflows.

llama3.2.summary: Meta's lightweight 1B and 3B text-only models; image understanding belongs to llama3.2-vision.

mistral.summary: This entry is Mistral 7B, not every Mistral-branded model. Instruct/completion variants differ; function calling is documented for v0.3.

codegemma.summary: Google's lightweight coding family has distinct pretrained completion and instruction-tuned chat variants.

nomic-embed-text.summary: Long-context text encoder for embeddings, not conversational generation.

codellama.summary: Meta's Llama-2-derived coding family includes instruct, Python-specialized, and base completion variants.

codestral.summary: This entry describes Mistral's 22B coding model trained across more than 80 languages, not later API-only namesakes.

llama-guard3.summary: Meta's classifier emits safe/unsafe judgments and hazard categories; it is not a general assistant or a safety guarantee.

gemma.summary: Google's original lightweight Gemma family, separate from Gemma 2 and later generations.

gemma2.summary: Google's second-generation Gemma models target text-focused assistant, content, research, and educational applications.

deepseek-coder-v2.summary: DeepSeek's MoE coding family; Lite and full-size results must not be conflated.

snowflake-arctic-embed.summary: Snowflake's retrieval-specific embedding family in multiple sizes, not a generative chat model.

mxbai-embed-large.summary: Mixedbread's retrieval encoder; the library demonstrates an instruction prefix for search queries.

llama3.2-vision.summary: Meta's 11B and 90B models accept text/images and return text; the library specifies English for image-plus-text applications.

llama3.3.summary: Meta's 70B text-only instruction model is optimized for multilingual dialogue; tools require integration.

smallthinker.summary: SmallThinker-3B-Preview is fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on long reasoning examples, distinct from other namesake checkpoints.

granite3.1-dense.summary: IBM's text-only dense 2B/8B models target tool-based applications and long-document processing.

granite3.1-moe.summary: IBM's long-context 1B/3B MoE models target low-latency deployment and multilingual document/tool applications.

llava.summary: Vision-language assistant family; LLaVA 1.6 improves image resolution, reasoning, and OCR.

qwq.summary: Qwen's reasoning family includes QwQ-32B; preview and release tags are not necessarily the same checkpoint.

phi4.summary: Microsoft's 14B instruction model primarily targets English and constrained deployment; distinct from Phi-4-reasoning.

phi4-mini.summary: Microsoft's lightweight Phi-4-mini-instruct targets multilingual commercial/research applications with function calling.

granite3.2.summary: IBM's long-context 2B/8B models build on Granite 3.1 with controllable thinking.

r1-1776.summary: Perplexity's post-trained DeepSeek-R1 derivative aims to reduce censorship-related refusals; publisher neutrality claims are not guarantees.

deepseek-v2.5.summary: Combines DeepSeek-V2-Chat conversational capabilities with DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct coding capabilities.

devstral.summary: Mistral and All Hands AI's text-only 24B agentic coding model derives from Mistral Small 3.1 with its vision encoder removed.

llama4.summary: Meta's multimodal MoE collection includes Scout/Maverick, accepting text/images and generating text/code; variant specs differ.

gemma3.summary: Google's family has text-only 270M/1B and image-capable 4B/12B/27B variants; vision/context claims are variant-specific.

deepseek-r1.summary: Includes a full MoE and distinct dense distillations. The full-model and Qwen3-derived 8B 0528 updates are not equivalent to other distilled tags.

gemma3n.summary: Device-oriented instruction models use selective parameter activation and effective E2B/E4B sizes, not those total parameter counts. Local image/audio availability was not verified; upstream model-card retrieval failed.

exaone-deep.summary: LG AI Research's reasoning family spans 2.4B/7.8B/32B models; results remain specific to the evaluated variant.
